name: – Isabel Wiseler-Lima – After § 45 – Am 61
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 45c. Urges the Member States and the EU to apply diplomatic, economic, and political pressure on third countries to promptly readmit their nationals who have committed crimes in the European Union, particularly those under legal and administrative expulsion orders; emphasises that cooperation agreements, trade relations, visa policies, and financial assistance to third countries should be contingent upon compliance with readmission obligations and calls for enhanced cooperation among Member States in this regard;
